literal: file rubbed metal like will-wear-away strength having-destroyed internal-enmity afflicted family
translation: A family afflicted by internal enmity will have its strength destroyed and wear away, just like metal rubbed by a file.
modern: அரத்தால் தேய்க்கப்பட்ட இரும்பு எப்படித் தேயுமோ, அதுபோல உட்பகை உள்ள குடியானது தன் வலிமை அழிந்து தேய்ந்து போகும்.
explanation: This couplet uses a vivid simile to illustrate the destructive nature of internal conflict. A file slowly but surely wears down even the hardest metal by constantly rubbing against it. Similarly, internal enmity acts as a hidden file within a family or group, continuously eroding its core strength. The word 'பொன்' here refers generally to hard metal, emphasizing that even the strongest household will eventually be destroyed from within if plagued by internal strife.
